title: Brass bands: Supreme Band, Maurice Durand, Eureka and Cashmere
summary: Clayton names trumpeters he played with and says he never led a brass band but joined the Eureka or John Casimir's band when hired.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I was going to ask a little bit about some of the brass bands that you've played in. Any regular band or just jobbing around different bands?
Well I played with, he's dead now, what is his name, he lived downtown, I believe he had the Supreme Band if I'm not mistaken. He was a good trumpet player, tall and bright fella.
I can't call his name. It's been Maurice Burand.
No, I know Maurice Burand, I used to play with him too.

He was sort of tall and heavy too, he is now. Well he died. No, he's, I think you went to San Francisco, we saw him two years, about three years ago and he was dead. Moran? Big Fat Moran? No, no, that's Herb Moran. Boyd Moran, yeah he's dead. Maurice Duran.
The Ninth Ward on Lazardi Street.
Yeah, I think he's living there. Yeah, he's out in California.
Yeah. Did you ever have a brass band of your own, Jimmy?
No, I didn't have a brass band. If people would hire me I'd just call up the Eureka or John Cashmere and I'd play with it. That'd be my band right on.
Yeah, I'd get jobs, I played right with them.
